$comment: TM-1180 path->tag e2e scoping map. scope-e2e.mjs (resolveScope) turns a WEB PR's changed files into a Playwright --grep so only the specs its change surface can affect run, instead of the full ~18-min matrix. SAFETY, by construction: (a) any file listed in forceFull, (b) any web/ file NOT under web/src/ (harness/e2e/assets), or (c) any web/src/ path that matches no map prefix => the FULL suite. `alwaysOn` tags are added to EVERY scoped run so the core path is never unguarded (they also guarantee the grep matches >=1 test, so Playwright never errors 'no tests found'). The nightly cron always runs FULL as the daily backstop, so an incomplete/imperfect map only costs speedup, never coverage. Every tag here must exist in the lint SURFACE set (lint-surface-tags.mjs). Playwright --grep is an UN-anchored regex over the full test title, so a shorter tag is a safe superset: `@notif` matches `@notifications`, `@venue` matches `@venues`, `@admin` matches `@admin-events`. Prefer over-inclusion (extra tags) to under-inclusion. Entries are matched in ORDER (first prefix wins) — keep the most specific prefixes first.
